invariants.name: palette_switch_does_not_reshape
invariants.note: Issue #100 §7: a palette-only change must not reshape text.

invariants.name: palette_switch_does_not_lay_out
invariants.note: Issue #100 §7: a palette-only change must not run layout.

invariants.name: palette_switch_does_not_lay_out_the_frame
invariants.note: Cross-check against the drain: no LAYOUT was scheduled either.

invariants.name: palette_switch_does_not_copy_layout
invariants.note: A palette-only change must not send the style path through LayoutStyle at all. The invalidation counters above stay at 0 even for a resolver that rebuilt every box, so this is the one that fails when sizing is resolved on the read path instead of the write path.

notes: Issue #101 §4 palette-only theme change (light<->dark). Phase 0 records the document-wide paint invalidation as it is; narrowing it is Issue #100 §7.
